name: server_healthcheck
description: Live health probe for LogOS verification surfaces: MCP registry, forge WS bridge (:8088), manifold dashboard API, optional edge endpoints. Returns per-service latency, ok flags, composite WAVE score on 0–100 scale, and operator-posture inputs; does not authorize publish or deploy by itself.

targets.description: Optional subset: registry | forge_ws | manifold | edge | all (default all)
